name: reply-summary
title: Reply summary
description: A "5 replies, last reply 2 hours ago" link with a small avatar stack that opens the thread, for message and comment lists.
docs: Put it under a message or comment. replies is the count (fewer than one draws nothing), repliers the people who replied, most recent first, of whom three are drawn, and lastReplyAt when the latest came in. With href the line is a link, without it a button; onOpen receives the click, so a client-side router can call preventDefault() and navigate itself. The whole line is one control named like View thread, 5 replies, 2 new, last reply 2 hours ago. unread is true for a plain New or a number for 2 new, always written as text. A count of 1000 or more compacts to 1.3k on the line and stays 1,284 in the name. The relative time is read once and never ticks; pass now to get it in server HTML, in tests and in previews, and locale and timeZone for the language and the zone of the date shown before the clock is known. The line reads its own column: narrow, the time is written short (2h ago) and the hover swap to View thread goes; narrower still the third avatar, the second and the chevron step aside, and if even that is too much the time drops to a second line. The time is never cut off. labels translates every word.
